name: @papercusp/ipc-endpoint-server
description: Host-agnostic Unix-socket/named-pipe server for the endpoint IPC protocol: framed REQUEST/CANCEL in, EVENT_JSON/EVENT_BIN/DONE/ERROR out, with the privileged sys:http HTTP-over-IPC bridge. Tool resolution, dispatch, and workspace state are injected via an IpcEndpointHost seam — zero registry or application coupling.
